formulas.name: formula_NetBookingAmountFormatted
formulas.expression: TEXT({!$Record.CurrencyIsoCode}) & " $" & IF({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c} < 1000, TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c})), IF({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c} < 100000, TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c}/1000)) & ',' & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c})),3), IF({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c} < 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c}/1000)) & "," & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c})),3), IF({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c} < 10000000, TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c}/1000000)) & ',' & MID(text({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c}),2,3) & "," & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c})),3), IF({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c} <100000000, TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c}/1000000)) & ',' & MID(text({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c}),3,3) & "," & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c})),3), "0"))))) & '.' & IF(FIND('.', TEXT({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c})) = 0, '00', IF(LEN(TEXT({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c})) - FIND('.', TEXT({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c})) = 1, RIGHT(TEXT({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c}),1) & '0', RIGHT(TEXT({!$Record.Net_Booking_Amount__c}),2)))

formulas.name: formula_ScreenMeetLineItemDetails
